title: August Billings, the Glessners' stable helper, in the stable yard
items: August Billings, the young Swedish helper the 1900 census finds living behind 1800 Prairie, now stands in the stable yard just inside the courtyard gates. Walk up to him to open his card.
He works in his shirt sleeves after a groom photographed about 1902: a striped shirt, black braces and a belt, dark trousers and a light felt hat.
